data:text/html,<body><canvas id="c"></canvas><style>body{margin:0;overflow:hidden;background:black}</style><script>const e=c.getContext("2d");let i={x:100,y:100,direction:"d"},t={x:400},n=!1;document.addEventListener("mousedown",()=>{n=!0}),document.addEventListener("mouseup",()=>{n=!1}),onresize=()=>{c.width=innerWidth,c.height=innerHeight},onresize();let o=0;requestAnimationFrame(function l(d){Math.min((d-o)/1e3,.1),i.direction=n?"u":"d","d"==i.direction?i.y+=1:i.y-=1,t.x-=2,o=d,e.fillStyle="black",e.fillRect(0,0,c.width,c.height),e.fillStyle="white",e.beginPath(),"d"==i.direction?(e.moveTo(i.x,i.y),e.lineTo(i.x+20,i.y-20),e.lineTo(i.x+40,i.y+20)):(e.moveTo(i.x,i.y),e.lineTo(i.x-20,i.y-20),e.lineTo(i.x+20,i.y-40)),e.fill(),e.fillStyle="green",e.fillRect(t.x,0,200,200),requestAnimationFrame(l)});</script></body>
